summary: Academic language polishing Skill with deterministic preservation guardrails (stdlib only). Rewrites for academic register and concision while preservation_check.py verifies survival of eight meaning-relevant categories: numbers/units, citations, figure/table/equation references, hedging terms, claim-strength verbs (strengthening AND weakening), negation scope, and strict quantifiers; it also flags heavy rewrites via sentence similarity. benchmark.py provides a runnable A/B against a bare LLM.

method.polish: register, concision, cohesion and terminology unification; hedges kept where the source is itself hedged.
method.guardrails: preservation_check.py extracts protected tokens (NUMBER_UNIT_RE, CITATION_RE, FIG_REF_RE, EQ_REF_RE), hedge markers, strong/weak claim verbs, negation markers and strict quantifiers, then verifies survival in the polished text; computes per-sentence SequenceMatcher ratio (>0.45 else heavy_rewrite flag).
method.claim_strength: detects both directions: strong verb dropped + weak verb added = weakening; weak dropped + strong added = strengthening.
method.benchmark: benchmark.py compares a bare LLM (0 check categories) vs this Skill (8 check categories) on the same deliberately-broken sample; gain is a run result.
method.determinism: no network; the checker is a pure function of original vs polished text.

self_test.input: synthetic example pair (original.txt / polished.txt, deliberately edited with removed hedges and citation [1,2]) plus claim-strength/negation/quantifier unit cases
self_test.result: preservation_report.json correctly flags removed hedges and citation; claim_strength/negation_lost/quantifiers_dropped each fire on their unit case; a good polish yields no false positives
self_test.notes: self-test is synthetic and explicitly not a hidden case answer; the platform supplies actual cases at evaluation time.

deviations_from_paper: Does not change facts, numbers, units, method names or conclusions; only rewrites surface phrasing.
Hedging strength is preserved: a hedged claim stays hedged, a firm claim stays firm.

failure_modes.handling: preservation_check.py warns when a protected token count drops via a variant (term_variant_check with stop set)
claim_strength_check flags strong->weak and weak->strong swaps
quantifier_check flags only/at least/at most/all/none dropped
sentence similarity below 0.45 flags the sentence for human review instead of silently accepting
